exam.exam_name: Madhya Pradesh Pre-Nursing Selection Test & General Nursing Training Test (MP PNST / GNMTST)
exam.conducting_body: Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB), Bhopal

source_evidence.captured_wording: Candidate profile template must be scanned between 200 KB and 220 KB in JPG format with photograph showing candidate name and date of photo taken.
source_evidence.document_title: Rulebook for Pre-Nursing Selection Test (PNST) and General Nursing & Midwifery Training Selection Test (GNMTST) 2024

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.

unsupported_requirement_reasons: The body requires the candidate's name and/or the photograph date printed on the image. The engine has no text-rendering capability, so the photograph is produced correctly sized and composed but without the imprint, which the candidate must add before uploading.

requirements.requirement_name: MPESB Composite Profile Template (Photo + Signature + Self Declaration)
requirements.content_instructions: JPG / JPEG; Standard MPESB official template; Single A4 sheet scanned template; White background template; Signature inside designated box on template; Candidate must be female domicile of Madhya Pradesh; verified against MP Online Profile

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Rulebook for Pre-Nursing Selection Test (PNST) and General Nursing & Midwifery Training Selection Test (GNMTST) 2024 - Profile Registration Annexure (https://esb.mp.gov.in/Rulebooks/RB_2024/PNST_GNMTST_2024_Rulebook.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Rulebook for Pre-Nursing Selection Test (PNST) and General Nursing & Midwifery Training Selection Test (GNMTST) 2024 - Profile Registration Annexure (https://esb.mp.gov.in/Rulebooks/RB_2024/PNST_GNMTST_2024_Rulebook.pdf)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
